items.review_rationale: Reviewed a kernel morphism's universal factorization in a preadditive category, retaining zero composites, unique mediation, arrow direction and conditional existence.

references.phrase: zero morphism f composed with i equals zero
references.context: Distinguished additive identity of the morphism abelian group Hom(K,Y), annihilated by composition.

references.phrase: universal factorization j=i composed with h
references.context: Every arrow j:Z→X killed by f factors through inclusion i:K→X.
For any arrow j killed by f, exactly one arrow h:Z→K makes the factorization commute.

references.disposition: A kernel universal morphism may not exist for every arrow of an arbitrary preadditive category.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed abelian category as additive category with all kernels/cokernels and invertible coimage-to-image comparison, distinguishing the categorical universal notions from set-theoretic images.

references.context: Cokernel of kernel of an arrow in an additive category, provided these constructions exist.
Kernel of cokernel of an arrow, a categorical image rather than the elementwise image of a set map.
Canonical morphism connecting the coimage and image by universal properties.
Arrow having a two-sided inverse under categorical composition.

references.phrase: every morphism has kernel and cokernel
references.disposition: Required universal availability distinguishes an abelian category from a merely additive one.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed additive category via finite products in a preadditive category, including empty product and equivalent zero-object and finite-direct-sum formulation.

references.phrase: finite categorical products including empty product
references.context: Existence of products for each finite family of objects, where the empty product is a terminal object.
Object simultaneously initial and terminal in a preadditive category.
Products and coproducts agreeing for finite families, with canonical injection and projection arrows.

references.disposition: These are equivalent characterizations of the same additive-category meaning, not a dependency upon itself.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed preadditive category as category with abelian-group hom-sets and bilinear composition, not assuming smallness or finite products from the stronger additive-category notion.

references.context: Objects, arrows, identities and associative composition without a small-category cardinality hypothesis.
Collection of arrows from X to Y, carrying its own abelian group structure.

references.phrase: composition Hom(Y,Z) x Hom(X,Y) to Hom(X,Z)
references.context: Partially typed composition of arrows, additive in each variable.

references.phrase: not necessarily small or additive category
references.disposition: Finite products and an underlying object set are not additional hypotheses in this formulation.
